demos.title: Apple HomeView Launch Reel
demos.script:
Apple ne ab tumhare ghar mein bhi entry maar di hai! Aur woh bhi poore 40,000 rupaye mein!

13 October ko Apple ne officially launch kar diya hai apna naya smart home device — Apple HomeView!

Ab socho, tum ghar mein enter karte ho aur ye device tumhara chehra pehchaan kar tumhari personal information screen par dikha deta hai!

Ismein hai 7-inch Liquid Retina display, AI-powered Siri, FaceTime video calling aur smart home automation.

Matlab ghar ki lights control karni ho, security camera check karna ho ya music play karna ho, sab kuch ek jagah!

Aur ismein ek 12-megapixel camera bhi hai, jo video call ke dauraan tumhe frame mein rakhta hai!

Lekin ab aati hai sabse interesting baat…

Iski price hai ₹39,900!

Pre-orders shuru ho chuke hain aur 13 November se ye available hoga.

Ab tum batao, kya ye future ke smart homes ki shuruaat hai, ya Apple ne ek aur mehenga gadget bana diya?

40,000 rupaye mein tum ye kharidoge ya nahi?
